title: orthosiphon thymiflorus
intro: Orthosiphon thymiflorus, commonly known as Miswak or Java tea, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Indonesia and Malaysia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving urinary function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Orthosiphon thymiflorus include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating urinary tract infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
